features.note: Recessed color-banked outlets now carry a silkscreen legend — outlet numbers (42,41,40...) read next to each receptacle in the detail view. Elevates the count/addressability read.
Unchanged; ?body=black now also renders the declared black variant.

head-detail: a LEGIBLE canvas nameplate reads PANDUIT / E42G20L / '60 A 3-PH · 17.3 kVA' / '42 OUT · IEC 60309 3P+E' — all sourced from P1; NO invented voltage (text discipline). Sells it as a specific monitored E42G20L, not a generic strip.

defects: Rating line on the nameplate is intentionally small (a real rating label is ~illegible at 0.5 m — enlarging it would be LESS faithful). Legible in the detail view; not meant to read at hero distance.
Legend numbers read clearly in detail but are subtle at full-strip hero distance (expected for 33:1).
corrections: lighting-camera pass: rig per spec, tune the emissive LCD glow; consider activating colorTarget (measure rendered red-body sRGB, deltaE00Max ~6) to lock the hero color before P6.

APPROVED: silkscreen legend numbering is [INFER] but functionally argued (a per-outlet-switched MSPO must print the outlet number to be addressable); nameplate text is all [CERT] from P1 with voltage deliberately omitted (unsourced).
